lines.text: The Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to Israel in chains and bow down to her.
The makers of idols will depart together in disgrace, but the LORD will save Israel with an everlasting salvation.
The LORD created the heavens, formed the earth, and did not create it to be empty but to be inhabited.
The LORD says those who carry idols of stone and pray to a god that cannot save are ignorant.
The LORD invites the borders of Judah to turn to Him and be saved, and swears every knee will bow.

wrong_details.true: all the ends of the earth
